propositions: docs/llm-framework.md does not document the runtime contract for repository-owned code-review project criteria flowing through the four-pass gate.
A normative 'Code-review project criteria' section with four subheadings must document Round A/B fan-in, Pass-3 effective routing, criteria eval resolution, and configuration errors.
Project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and never into round_b, whose membership is escalation/overlay-controlled.
A project code-review id active in exactly one gate resolves through the code-review arm of criteria eval; unknown or cross-gate-ambiguous ids are rejected before calibration.
An activated project criterion with a missing or invalid prompt/eval specification raises a located configuration error rather than silently falling back.
No production behavior changes; verification is a deterministic documentation-content check against required headings and contract markers.
